description: This file is an HTML webpage for a Database Viewer application. It contains the structure and styling for a UI that allows browsing database connections, listing tables, and displaying table data with interactive and dynamic features implemented via embedded JavaScript.
external_methods: fetchData (used multiple times to fetch data from API endpoints)

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar UI.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays the tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and renders data of a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders table data into an HTML table with interactive cells.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell value, handling objects, nulls, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full data.
